Perfect! All tests now pass. I fixed two issues in the code:

1. Updated the `WORD_RE` regex pattern from `r"[a-z]+"` to `r"[a-z']+"` to include apostrophes as part of words, so "don't" is recognized as a single word
2. Modified the `top_words` sorting key from `lambda kv: -kv[1]` to `lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0])` to break ties alphabetically when words have the same frequency
